tic-tac-toe.slogan: Enjoy the timeless fun of Tic Tac Toe!
tic-tac-toe.description: Tic Tac Toe, also known as Noughts and Crosses, is a classic and popular game enjoyed by people of all ages. It is a simple yet engaging game played on a grid of 3x3 squares. The objective is to create a line of three matching symbols (either X or O) horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Play Tic Tac Toe now and challenge your friends!

HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Tic Tac Toe | Classic X and O Game
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Tic Tac Toe, also known as Noughts and Crosses, is a classic and popular game enjoyed by people of all ages. It is a simple yet engaging game played on a grid of 3x3 squares.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Two players take turns placing their chosen symbol (X or O) on an empty square of the grid.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: The first player usually starts with X, and the second player follows with O.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: The game continues until one player successfully forms a line of three symbols or all the squares on the grid are filled, resulting in a draw.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Easy to learn and play, making it accessible to all ages.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Fast-paced and perfect for short breaks.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Encourages players to think ahead and plan their moves.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Replayable and always a challenge with different opponents.
